_about: Unresolved data gaps. status: open, partly_resolved, resolved.

gaps.title: Saffire-V V-4 atmosphere conflict
gaps.detail: NASA's as-executed matrix gives 72.6 kPa and 25.7 mol% O2 (SRC-URBAN-2021 slide 5); the ZARM slides give 761 hPa and 26.9 vol% inflow (SRC-EIGENBROD-2021 slide 3). The service reports both.
gaps.resolution_path: Obtain the written ICES-2021-218 paper or ask the authors.

gaps.title: No numeric Saffire-V flame tracking
gaps.detail: Flame-front, flame-length and flicker plots (ZARM slides 7-9) export with axes only. No spread rates per rib are available; the 0.88 mm/s value in an earlier brief has no source and is excluded.
gaps.resolution_path: Written ICES-2021-218 paper; request tracking data from ZARM; do not digitize or simulate.

gaps.title: No public raw imagery for Saffire IV-VI or SoFIE-GEL
gaps.detail: No PSI record found for Saffire IV-VI or SoFIE-GEL in mirrored PSI catalogs (2026-11-13); NASA Glenn's Saffire data portal is for authorized users only. A public NASA video of the Saffire-V ribbed PMMA burn exists in the NASA image and video library (Jan 12, 2021) but is not calibrated tracking data.
gaps.resolution_path: Check psi.nasa.gov directly in a browser; request access through PSI.

gaps.title: Per-step oxygen not tabulated
gaps.detail: BASS-II measured oxygen only at the start and end of each test. NASA's per-step estimates (linear decay, p. 60) are plotted but not tabulated, so flow and oxygen effects cannot be separated within a test.
gaps.resolution_path: Request Figures 5.8-5.9 data from the investigators.

gaps.title: Rod spread rates not in the service
gaps.detail: Per-test opposed spread rates for the Fernandez-Pello rods are in the supplementary tables of Link et al. 2018, not obtained.

gaps.title: Flow configuration unresolved for 5 tests
gaps.detail: O1 and O2 are printed as '?' in Appendix A; O20-O22 (February 2016) are not in Appendix A.

gaps.title: SoFIE-GEL journal article not read
gaps.detail: A July 2025 article extends the range to 13-34% O2 and 0.15-1.1 atm. Only the manuscript (NTRS 20240007628) was read.

gaps.title: PSI Saffire I-III tables not reconciled with NTRS
gaps.detail: Another team reports PSI-99 and NTRS disagree for samples 2-1 (oxygen) and 2-6 (flow).
gaps.resolution_path: Reconcile before any numeric Saffire layer.

gaps.title: FLEX test count mismatch
gaps.detail: Report lists 284 tests; the PSI-69 table has 274 rows.

gaps.title: Olson rod test count
gaps.detail: Olson and Ferkul 2015 reports 24 tests; the Summary Report lists 27 including O20-O22 run in February 2016.
